programs.name: Visiting Student Researcher (VSR) status at Stanford (faculty-hosted)

The student has to find a host in Genetics, Biomedical Data Science or a related department.
programs.eligibility: Students currently enrolled in a graduate degree program at another university who will do research under a Stanford faculty member. Status is valid for up to 1 year and can be extended once for a second year. Stanford does not guarantee funding. A visa is likely needed for a Canadian student.
programs.deadline_text: No central deadline. Arranged with the host lab and department.

programs.eligibility: Postdoc-level, not for current PhD students. The advert does not mention nationality, but a UK visa would be needed. Open to computational and interdisciplinary projects.
programs.location: London, UK (Francis Crick Institute plus a partner university)
programs.duration: 4 years, full-time, fixed-term, with time split equally between the two groups
programs.deadline_text: Closing date 6 January 2027 per the jobs.ac.uk advert. Another search result said 30 November 2026, so confirm on the Cr

programs.name: Crick technical training courses (in-person and on-demand)
programs.requirements: Not verified. Contact techtraining@crick.ac.uk.
programs.eligibility: Unverified whether external PhD students can attend. One secondary source says some short courses are open to external participants. A 2021 Crick notice suggests bioinformatics courses are mainly for Crick scientists.
programs.deadline_text: Not verified

programs.name: EMBL-EBI: Introduction to RNA-seq and functional interpretation (2027, virtual course)
programs.requirements: Application via the course page. Selected applicants give a short flash talk about their research at registration. Some R and Linux experience is helpful but not required. Fee is £250 for academia. Fee waivers and travel grants are available on request.
programs.eligibility: Life science researchers from wet or dry labs. 35 places, selected by application. Open internationally, but you must be available 09:00–17:30 UK time each day.
programs.location: Virtual (Zoom, Slack and EMBL-EBI virtual training infrastructure)
programs.deadline_text: Applications close 22 Nov 2026 23:59 UK time. Outcomes by 4 Dec 2026.

programs.name: EMBO Practical Course: Multi-omics data integration and visualisation (2027)
programs.requirements: Application via the EMBL-EBI Training events page. Fee from £975 including catering and accommodation. Financial assistance and travel grants are available on request. The fee and deadline come from an EMBL-EBI Training social media post dated 26 Aug 2026, not from the course page, so verify them.
programs.eligibility: Not confirmed on an official course page. International applicants are generally accepted at EMBL-EBI courses, but check.
programs.location: Likely Hinxton, UK (the venue is not confirmed)
programs.duration: About 6 days (31 Jan – 5 Feb 2027, per the EMBL poster)
programs.deadline_text: 22 Nov 2026 (from the social media post only; unverified on the official course page)

programs.name: EMBL Courses and Conferences 2027 programme (EMBL-EBI and EMBL courses, workshops)
programs.requirements: Varies by event. Most need an online application with a motivation statement. Many offer fee waivers or travel grants.
programs.eligibility: Generally open to international researchers and PhD students. Check each event page.
programs.location: Hinxton UK, Heidelberg DE, or virtual
programs.deadline_text: Varies per course. Further events are being added during 2026.

programs.name: EIPOD-LinC (Exploring Life in Context) postdoctoral fellowship, 2026 call
programs.requirements: PhD awarded or defended by 1 Feb 2027, with up to 8 years of research experience since the PhD. Needs an EMBL host (EMBL-EBI hosts are possible) and a partner lab in an EMBL Member, Associate or Prospect Member State. Includes a 3–12 month secondment. Two references and an application in English.
programs.eligibility: Postdoctoral candidates of all nationalities. Not for current PhD students, but a possible next step once you have your PhD.
programs.location: EMBL site (including EMBL-EBI, Hinxton) plus a partner lab in an EMBL Member State
programs.deadline_text: Applications open 25 Nov 2026 and close 1 Feb 2027. Information webinar 19 Nov 2026. Interviews 8–9 Apr 2027.

programs.name: ESPOD: EMBL-EBI–Wellcome Sanger Institute Postdoctoral Fellowships
programs.requirements: Cover letter, CV and two recent reference letters. Self-proposed projects must involve at least one EMBL-EBI group and one Sanger group, approved by the group leaders beforehand. The start date must fall within 12 months of the award.
programs.eligibility: Postdoctoral level. Degree and nationality criteria are not stated on the page. Not for current PhD students.
programs.location: EMBL-EBI and Wellcome Sanger Institute, Wellcome Genome Campus, Hinxton, UK
programs.deadline_text: The 2026 call is closed (interviews 10 Dec 2026). The next call is expected in 2027 but has not been announced.

programs.name: EMBL Scientific Visitor Programme (PhD student visits to EMBL-EBI groups)
programs.requirements: Agree a collaboration or visit with an EMBL-EBI group leader first. Complete the fellowship eligibility questionnaire. Funding options listed for PhD students include EMBO Scientific Exchange grants, Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds travel grants, IUBMB and Theory@EMBL. The programme page gives no application deadlines.
programs.eligibility: External PhD students, with a host group leader's agreement. Funding schemes have their own criteria. Canadians are not excluded on the page, but check each scheme.
programs.location: EMBL-EBI, Hinxton, UK (or other EMBL sites)
programs.duration: Short-term, set by the host and scheme
programs.deadline_text: No fixed deadline on the programme page. Deadlines depend on the funding scheme.

programs.name: EMBL International PhD Programme (EMBL-EBI, 2027 Winter call)
programs.requirements: Online application with two chosen EMBL research units, up to four research areas, and references. Not free of cost to check eligibility: the page lists no criteria, so see the application page. No fee.
programs.eligibility: Prospective PhD students. Not for you as a current PhD student, unless you were to transfer. Listed so you know when the next call will be.
programs.location: EMBL-EBI (Hinxton, UK) and other EMBL sites
programs.duration: PhD, with a start by Oct 2027
programs.deadline_text: Closed 12 Oct 2026 (references 14 Oct). Interviews are virtual, in Jan 2027.

programs.name: LMB PhD Studentship 2027 entry (open competition; includes computational project e.g. David Barford 'Machine learning for finding macromolecules in cells')
programs.requirements: Application through the University of Cambridge portal; applicants are encouraged to contact prospective supervisors. Detailed eligibility is not on the page.
programs.eligibility: Funding is open to prospective students of all nationalities through open competition. This is a new PhD, so it only suits the student if they would restart their doctorate. Research-only MPhil is considered only in exceptional cases.
programs.duration: PhD (length not stated on the page)
programs.deadline_text: Tuesday 8th December 2026

programs.name: LMB Rising Talent Fellowship (for scientists of Black heritage)
programs.requirements: Self-identifies as being from a Black heritage background (including mixed). Has postdoc experience or a relevant PhD. A candidate still studying must be within 6 months of the expected thesis submission date.
programs.eligibility: The page does not state nationality or visa criteria. It mentions relocation guidance. This round is closed and no future round is announced.
programs.deadline_text: Applications closed 17 May 2026; start dates October to December 2026

programs.name: LMB Career Returner Fellowship
programs.requirements: Postdoctoral fellowship for researchers returning after a career break of 12 months or more. The page gives no other details.
programs.eligibility: Not applicable to a current PhD student. International eligibility is not stated.
programs.deadline_text: No deadline stated; check the LMB current vacancies list

programs.name: LMB Student Placement Scheme
programs.requirements: Undergraduate status and interest in a research career.
programs.eligibility: For undergraduates only, so a PhD student cannot apply. Applicants must be UK nationals or meet UK residence requirements. Overseas students enrolled full time at a UK university can apply, and others can apply via the UKRI Temporary Worker Exchange Scheme.
programs.deadline_text: 2026 scheme closed; no 2027 date listed

programs.name: LMB Training Seminars (Electron Cryomicroscopy 2023 and Molecular Techniques 2025 lecture series)
programs.requirements: None stated. The series are pitched at research students with no prior knowledge of the techniques.
programs.eligibility: Past series are available as recordings on the LMB YouTube channel. The page does not say whether external people can attend live. Content is structural and molecular biology, not bioinformatics.
programs.deadline_text: No upcoming course listed on the page
